data.title: American Council of Learned Societies Announces Winners of 2026 ACLS Open Access Book Prizes and Arcadia Open Access Publishing Awards
data.description: Winners of the 2026 ACLS Open Access Book Prizes, each receiving $50,000, have been revealed by the American Council of Learned Societies (ACLS). The awards recognize exceptional contributions in the humanities and support forthcoming open access publications. This initiative aims to advance academic research and encourage accessibility in scholarly works.

data.title: WAYNE MATLOCK WINS SCORE BAJA 400 IN POLARIS RZR PRO R FACTORY, CLAIMS $50,000 POLARIS SCORE CHALLENGE
data.description: Ethan Groom of RZR Factory Racing secured a second-place finish, while Dallas Gonzalez Jr. grabbed third, completing a full podium sweep for the team in the latest event. Taking place on September 15, 2026, in Minneapolis, this event marked Polaris' strong performance in the SCORE series. The team's achievement included capturing all the top spots in the UTV Overall category at the 7th SCORE race.

data.title: LAZ Parking Accelerates Expansion Across North America, Creating More Than 1,000 New Jobs While Launching a Visionary Leadership Continuity Plan
data.description: A prominent company in North America that specializes in mobility, transportation, and parking is making strides with its "LAZ 3.0" initiative by prioritizing investments in technology, expansion, personnel, and grooming new leaders, as it enlarges its Hartford base. Headquartered in Hartford, Connecticut, the company is the leading privately owned entity in its sector in North America and is focusing on bolstering its operations for the future. The developments were announced on September 15, 2026.

data.title: Roland DG Launches Dimense Surface Textured Wallcoverings and Print Provider Program, Further Expanding the Possibilities for Dimense Technology
data.description: A new premium interior wallcovering brand has recently debuted, unveiling an exclusive designer Collaboration Series. This series highlights the innovative capabilities of Dimense printing technology. The launch took place in Irvine, California on September 15, 2026. Roland DG, a global leader in digital printing solutions, spearheaded this initiative. This collaboration signifies a major step forward in the industry, showcasing the exciting possibilities of combining creativity with advanced printing techniques.
